title: The kb's .claude kb-sprint, kb-item, kb-backlog and kb-worker entries link to the plugin's files, so one set exists and a clone without the plugin still runs its sprint
goal: Each of .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/kb-item/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/kb-backlog/SKILL.md and .claude/agents/kb-worker.md is a relative symlink to the plugin's skills/sprint/SKILL.md, skills/item/SKILL.md, skills/backlog/SKILL.md and agents/worker.md (the gate on a clone without the plugin: the text exists once, the kb-* names keep serving the clone's own sprint); no other file under those four holds a copy of the text; kb/_self/map.csv maps the plugin's files to the docs it mapped the .claude ones to, so selfdoc stale and the brief's docs list keep working; the docs that name the old paths (AGENTS.md, maintaining.md, backlog.md) say where the files are, AGENTS.md within its 4 KB cap
notes: Research ST-m6uyo6rw (landed c8d551aac): a <skill-name> folder entry under .claude/skills/ may be a symlink, read from its target (kb/public/claude/skills-and-subagents.md:65); no page says a symlinked SKILL.md file or a symlinked agent file under .claude/agents is followed (gap in _gaps.md); claude plugin validate counts a linked entry as one a session would load (plugins.md:43). A worktree with no .claude/skills at its root reads the main checkout (skills-and-subagents.md:69-76). Orchestrator at dispatch: the suite stands at 99 of 100 test ids after TK-p7ajxp72 (_tools/tests_ceiling.json), and the full suite sits near the 20 s darwin ceiling: the plugin_sprint_one_set check fits by extending an existing test or replacing one, not by adding several. A headless worker cannot write under .claude/: make no staging copies of the four files; say in the report which symlinks to make (link path and relative target), and the orchestrator makes them in the worktree and runs the checks. The docs say only that a symlinked skill folder is followed: if a file-level SKILL.md link is not proven to load (a claude -p probe in the scratch directory may show it), record that as a gate on the item.
